title: OpenSSH User Enumeration Vulnerability
description: OpenSSH through 7.7 is prone to a user enumeration vulnerability due to improper bailout handling.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 7.8 or later

title: OpenSSH Command Injection
description: scp in OpenSSH through 8.3p1 allows command injection in the scp.c toremote function.
remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 8.4 or later

title: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal
description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 is vulnerable to a path traversal flaw allowing unauthorized file access.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 or later

title: Apache HTTP Server RCE via Path Traversal
description: Apache HTTP Server insufficient fix for CVE-2021-41773 allows RCE via crafted requests.
remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later

title: Nginx HTTP Request Smuggling
description: NGINX before 1.17.7 with certain error_page configurations allows HTTP request smuggling.
remediation: Upgrade to Nginx 1.17.8 or later

title: MySQL Server DML Vulnerability
description: MySQL Server DML component flaw allowing potential unauthorized access.
remediation: Upgrade to MySQL 8.0.24 or 5.7.34

title: ProFTPD mod_copy Information Disclosure
description: ProFTPD 1.3.6 is vulnerable to memory pool corruption during data transfer interruption.
remediation: Upgrade to ProFTPD 1.3.7 or later

title: Log4Shell Remote Code Execution

remediation: Upgrade to Log4j 2.16 or later

title: BlueKeep RDP Remote Code Execution
